items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: When Victor came to the States... he hooked up with Hugh Masekela who was living in the Bronx at the time.

ctx.x: Had Dave played in South Africa?

Yeah. In 1976. And it was just before the cultural boycott had been announced and there was some opposition to it but by — well mainly what this did is we went on tour in South Africa as The New Brubeck Quartet. That was Dave, Chris on bass and trombone, and Dan, and our agent at the time Associated Booking Corporation (ABC) — I never go into this kind of detail with journalists but I suppose for an archival interview it’s good to know that kind of stuff — and parenthetically every imaginable pertinent document…

Cathy Morphet — Shallis was her maiden name. Cathy Morphet from her second husband — first husband. I’m further down the line — M-O-R-P-H-E-T — went on the road as kind of a liaison person but the thing is with the local contacts that she had and on the surface the local contacts were some music people that she knew. She had always been involved with jazz, and kind of less overtly with a kind of liberation organization people who were, you know that was all kind of off-the-record stuff but constantly taking the…
